scope: Complex positive finite block matrices, exact vacuum zero direction, nonzero coupling and both source components. Original a_j=(100j)^-1 and s_j=kappa/j used in fixtures. Both low and high energy scales retained. These matrices are algebra diagnostics, not Yang–Mills vacuum spectra.
